title: "Session 13 · Final-Project Help Session"
subtitle: "Open Q&A · code clinic · project check-ins"

No new material this session — it exists entirely to get your final project over the line. Session 12 completed the toolbox and Checkpoint 4 fit your actual model, so your project already exists in pieces; today is the buffer built into the course for turning those pieces into a finished submission before Sunday's deadline, with live debugging help in the room. The deal is simple: arrive with a runnable draft and your two hardest problems, leave with them solved.

## Learning objectives

By the end of this session you can:

- arrive with a runnable draft of your project script and your two most stuck-on problems written down
- leave with those two problems solved — or with a concrete plan for each
- say your results out loud in plain language before you write them into the report
- state exactly what's due Sunday and what the Session 14 presentation requires

## Before class

- Bring your **project code and data**, in whatever state they're in
- Review your [checkpoint feedback](../final-project.qmd) from Sessions 8–12
- Write down your two most stuck-on problems (code errors, interpretation doubts, "is this the right test?" questions)

## In class

- Open code clinic — bring errors, we debug them live
- Interpretation workshopping — say your results out loud in plain language before you write them
- Presentation logistics for Session 14: the **presentation order is announced today**. The format, time budget (8 min + 2 min Q&A), and grading criteria are already published in the [presentation spec](../final-project.qmd#the-presentation-8-of-course-grade) — read it before class so today's questions can be about *your* presentation

## After class

- **Full project submission is due via Canvas before midnight Sunday** — R script, dataset, and written report ([details](../final-project.qmd))
- Presentations are in class at Session 14
